2: For the music director. A psalm of David. A song. Praise awaits you, O God, in Zion, and to you the vow shall be fulfilled.
3: O you who hear prayer, to you all flesh will come.
4: Iniquities prevail over me. As for our transgressions, you will ⌞forgive⌟ them.
5: Blessed is one whom you choose and bring near, that he may abide in your courts. We will be satisfied with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.
6: By awesome deeds in righteousness you will answer us, O God of our salvation, you who are the confidence of all the ends of the earth and of the far-off seas,
7: who established the mountains by his strength, the one who is girded with might,
8: who stills the roar of the seas, the roar of their waves, and the commotion of the peoples,
9: so that the inhabitants of the farthest reaches are in awe of your signs. You make the dawn and sunset sing for joy.
10: You care for the land and water it; you greatly enrich it. The stream of God is filled with waters. You provide their grain, for so you have established it.
11: You drench its furrows, penetrating its ridges. With rains you soften it; its growth you bless.
12: You crown the year with your ⌞bounty⌟, and your wagon paths drip with ⌞richness⌟.
13: They drop on the pastures of the wilderness, and the hills gird themselves with joy.
14: The pasturelands put on flocks, and the valleys clothe themselves with grain. They shout in triumph; they even sing.
